<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks in the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm): 138.76 ppm (1 carbon), 131.45 ppm (2 carbons), 130.59 ppm (2 carbons), and 121.30 ppm (1 carbon). Summing these gives 1 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 6 aromatic carbon atoms. The remaining peaks (43.47 and 38.60 ppm) are aliphatic. Therefore, the compound contains 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
